{{Quote|Is it true a Jedi might be responsible for the attack?|This witness, inquiring about a certain rumor|<ref name="Sabotage" />}}
This '''[[Human/Legends|Human]]''' worked as a [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|hangar]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].

==History==
After a [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]] [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|went off]] in the hangar, this human [[Gender/Legends|male]] was taken to the hospital. As a [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droid]] was operating on him, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] asked this worker if he had witnessed anything strange before the explosion. The worker answered that everything seemed okay, and whisperingly asked if it was true that a Jedi was responsible for the bombing. Ahsoka replied that they didn't know anything for sure by then.<ref name="Sabotage" />
